short: Dirichlet L-zeros in the strip lie on the line

statements.markdown: Statement 2.3 (LFunction_eq_zero_re). For every modulus N ≥ 1, every Dirichlet character χ modulo N and every s with 0 < Re s < 1 and L(s, χ) = 0, one has Re s = 12 .

lean.name: LFunction_eq_zero_re
lean.plain: Dirichlet L-zeros in the strip lie on the line
lean.fidelity_note: `DirichletLZerosOnLine` quantifies over every character of every positive modulus, including imprimitive characters. A zero in the same open strip $0<\operatorname{Re}s<1$ has $\operatorname{Re}s=1/2$.
